entities.name: Timothy A. McDonnell

entities.summary: Timothy Anthony McDonnell was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Springfield in Massachusetts from 2004 to 2014 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of New York from 2001 to 2004.
